In the compounds अहिताग्नि and the like, the निष्ठा-formed word may optionally be placed first.

Terms: समास-बहुव्रीही-निष्ठा

The word वह्यं is irregularly formed when the meaning of the word is an instrument of carrying.

Terms: Irregular

The affix खश् comes after the verb लिह 'to lick' when the object in composition with it, is the word वह 'the shoulder of an ox' or अभ्र 'a cloud'.

Terms: खश्

The affix णिव after the verb वह् 'to carry' in the छन्दस् (Vedas), when the word ending in case-affix is in composition with it.

Terms: छन्दस्

The feminine affix ङीष् comes after a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) ending with the word वाह्।

Terms: विभक्ति-ङीष्

The affixes ठञ् and ञिठ् come in the remaining senses after the वृद्ध words denoting the villages of वाहीक।

Terms: ठञ् and ञिठ्

The व is vocalised to ऊ (ऊठ्) when the compound अङ्ग (stem) is भ।

Terms: भ substitution

The न of वाहन is changed into ण , when the letter producing the change, occurs in the first member of a compound, denoting the thing carried.

Terms: सन्धि-हल्-word
